meta.name: sandbox-next
meta.description: Build or maintain Cloudflare Sandbox apps on @cloudflare/sandbox@next (SDK 1.0 preview). Use sandbox-migrate-to-next when porting a stable app.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搭建或维护基于新版 SDK 的 Cloudflare 沙盒应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在用预览版 SDK 开发或维护 Cloudflare 沙盒应用。
copy.tagline_en: Build or maintain Cloudflare Sandbox apps using the preview SDK.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building or maintaining Cloudflare Sandbox apps on the preview SDK.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在 @cloudflare/sandbox@next(SDK 1.0 预览)这一线上帮你写和维护 Cloudflare Sandbox 应用:先核对 npm 依赖和容器镜像是否同属预览线,再按 exec 句柄、终端等契约产出代码。
howto.when: 当项目已用 @cloudflare/sandbox@next 或预览镜像,或你要新建、维护 1.0 预览版应用时接管;若项目还在默认包,会改用 sandbox-stable,移植则改用 sandbox-migrate-to-next。

say.text: 检查我的依赖和容器镜像是不是同一条 @next 线
say.note: 不匹配会停下并让你换对应技能

say.text: 用 sandbox.exec 跑段 python 并把输出取回来
say.note: 会按 argv 写法配 output() 取结果

howto.what_en: With this installed, Claude builds and maintains Cloudflare Sandbox apps on @cloudflare/sandbox@next (SDK 1.0 preview): it first checks the npm dependency and container image sit on the same preview line, then writes code per the exec handle and terminal contract.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a project uses @cloudflare/sandbox@next or a preview container image, or when you start or maintain a 1.0 preview app. Default-package apps go to sandbox-stable; ports go to sandbox-migrate-to-next.

say_en.text: Build me a new Worker with @cloudflare/sandbox@next
say_en.note: Checks dependency and image are on the preview line first

say_en.text: Check if my dependency and container image are both @next
say_en.note: Stops and points you to the matching skill if not

say_en.text: Run some python via sandbox.exec and fetch the output
say_en.note: Shows argv form plus output() for results
